notes: #7 (Senate Square, the Lutheran Cathedral and the Alexander II statue, photochrom 1896, very large) is the strongest landmark scene and a good alternative to #9 for P4. #6 (le Moine painting, 1824, color) was passed over for #2 because it predates the cathedral and shows no recognizable landmark. #1 (Lauvergne, about 1840) shows no recognizable landmark. #2 is dated only to the years the work appeared in parts (1845–52).
